# Avente Hub

> Avente Hub (Avente Canada Inc., Vaughan, Ontario) supplies factory-direct GRF (Green, Resilient, Fast) building finishes to developers and builders in the Greater Toronto Area and in Florida. We bring sample boards to your office or site. Phone +1 (416) 450-6656, Max@aventehub.com, https://aventehub.com

Products are sold in two packs: the Lighting pack (LED crown moulding, LED neon flex, LED strips, running light strip, magnetic track lighting, LED baseboards) and the Door pack (WPC interior doors, wood-grain aluminum baseboards). Every product carries an AVH code and is available in Toronto and Florida.
